prompts.prompt: Use case stylized-concept. Asset: one production RPG environment sprite atlas for a top-down 2D pixel-art game. Exactly THREE columns by TWO rows, six equal square cells, landscape 3:2 canvas e.g. 1536x1024. TRUE transparent background between all objects. One isolated FULL object per cell with plenty of transparent margin; centered in cell, feet/base at 85% of cell height. No text, no borders, no ground squares, no UI. ALL objects same orthographic overhead three-quarter camera, front faces toward bottom. Authentic crisp 16-bit handheld RPG pixel art: strong dark pixel outlines, discrete stepped square pixels, limited harmonious palette, clustered highlights and shadows. Draw at apparent 96x96 pixel resolution scaled up with NEAREST NEIGHBOR, NOT painterly, NOT vector clipart, NO antialiasing. Detailed coherent craft and texture comparable to classic monster RPG environment art. Keep all cells independent and aligned. Rows left to right: TOP ROW: 1 lush mature eucalyptus-like park tree with rounded irregular leafy crown, textured bark, visible trunk and roots; 2 warm wooden slatted Lima park bench on ornate dark cast iron legs; 3 low stone rectangular planter with red and white flowers and dark green leaves. BOTTOM ROW: 4 sturdy wooden breakable supply crate with diagonal planks; 5 recognizable stylized Campo de Marte commemorative pale stone arch monument, stepped base, small bronze figures at sides and upper part, red-white Peruvian flags, compact but majestic, front-facing with stone arch passage; 6 ornate black urban lamppost with warm amber lantern. Theme: Campo de Marte Lima, warm greens, cream stone, brown wood. Tiny ground contact shadows ONLY, no large cast shadow or background.

Use case stylized-concept. Asset: one terrain tileset, exactly THREE equal columns and TWO equal rows on a 3:2 opaque canvas 1536x1024. No gaps, no labels, no borders. Each square cell is an independent SEAMLESS TILE whose opposite edges match. Top row left to right: 1 deep rich green park grass with tiny square blade clusters and rare single-pixel flowers; 2 warm beige-gray small colonial cobblestone paving; 3 Andean olive-green short grass with subtle earth patches. Bottom row left to right: 4 pale warm compacted sandy park path; 5 broad gray-beige colonial paving slabs; 6 rough light granite Inca footpath flagstones. Authentic crisp 16-bit handheld RPG terrain tiles, low contrast ground so character sprites readable. Pixel resolution should appear 64x64 per tile scaled up nearest-neighbor with obvious square pixels; no smooth shading, no painterly texture, no outlines around the six cells. Consistent lighting, restrained palettes. Grass upper-left belongs to Campo de Marte Lima, cobbles upper-center Plaza de Armas Lima, grass upper-right Machu Picchu. Path tiles below match palette of tile directly above.
